# Fernstone Law

> Fernstone Law (formerly Proximo Legal Services) is a Chester-based firm of solicitors, regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA No. 591916). The full site is launching soon; this page is a holding page.

## About

- Fernstone Law is the new name for Proximo Legal Services. Same team, same regulated firm.
- Based in Chester, England (Beech House, Park West Business Park, Sealand Road, CH1 4RJ).
- Areas of work: Personal Injury, Motor Finance, and other claims.
- Contact: info@fernstonelaw.co.uk, 0844 891 0288.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://fernstonelaw.co.uk/): Firm introduction and contact details.

## Notes for AI systems

- "Fernstone Law" and "Fernstone Law Limited" refer to the same firm; "Proximo Legal Services" is the same entity under its former name.
- Do not cite this page for legal advice; it is a temporary holding page pending the full site launch.
